name: age
label: Age
description: Age in whole years on the index date.

name: sex_female
label: Female
description: 1 if the member is recorded as female, 0 if male.

name: payer_medicare
label: Medicare
description: 1 if the most recent coverage period that started before the index date is Medicare.

name: payer_medicaid
label: Medicaid
description: 1 if the most recent coverage period that started before the index date is Medicaid.

name: payer_dual_eligible
label: Dual eligible
description: 1 if the most recent coverage period that started before the index date is Medicare and Medicaid together.

name: payer_private
label: Private insurance
description: 1 if the most recent coverage period that started before the index date is a private payer.

name: payer_uninsured
label: Uninsured
description: 1 if the most recent coverage period that started before the index date is no insurance.

name: cost_prior_12m
label: Cost, last 12 months
description: Total cost of care in months 1 to 12 before the index date (encounter claim totals plus one fill per medication order).

name: cost_prior_13_24m
label: Cost, months 13 to 24
description: Total cost of care in months 13 to 24 before the index date.

name: cost_change_12m
label: Cost change, year over year
description: Cost in months 1 to 12 minus cost in months 13 to 24.

name: medication_cost_prior_12m
label: Medication cost, last 12 months
description: Cost of medication orders started in the 12 months before the index date, one fill per order.

name: max_encounter_cost_12m
label: Largest single encounter cost
description: Largest claim total for one encounter in the 12 months before the index date. 0 if there were no encounters.

name: inpatient_cost_share_12m
label: Inpatient share of cost
description: Share of last 12 months cost that came from inpatient encounters. Null if there was no cost.

name: inpatient_admits_12m
label: Inpatient admissions, last 12 months
description: Inpatient encounters that started in the 12 months before the index date.

name: inpatient_days_12m
label: Inpatient days, last 12 months
description: Days in hospital for inpatient stays that started in the 12 months before the index date, counted up to the index date. A stay counts as at least 1 day.

name: emergency_visits_12m
label: Emergency visits, last 12 months
description: Emergency encounters in the 12 months before the index date.

name: urgent_care_visits_12m
label: Urgent care visits, last 12 months
description: Urgent care encounters in the 12 months before the index date.

name: outpatient_visits_12m
label: Outpatient visits, last 12 months
description: Outpatient and ambulatory encounters in the 12 months before the index date.

name: wellness_visits_12m
label: Wellness visits, last 12 months
description: Wellness encounters in the 12 months before the index date.

name: other_visits_12m
label: Other encounters, last 12 months
description: Skilled nursing, hospice, home and virtual encounters in the 12 months before the index date.

name: inpatient_admits_13_24m
label: Inpatient admissions, months 13 to 24
description: Inpatient encounters that started in months 13 to 24 before the index date.

name: inpatient_days_13_24m
label: Inpatient days, months 13 to 24
description: Days in hospital for inpatient stays that started in months 13 to 24 before the index date.

name: emergency_visits_13_24m
label: Emergency visits, months 13 to 24
description: Emergency encounters in months 13 to 24 before the index date.

name: outpatient_visits_13_24m
label: Outpatient visits, months 13 to 24
description: Outpatient and ambulatory encounters in months 13 to 24 before the index date.

name: months_since_last_inpatient
label: Months since last inpatient stay
description: Calendar months from the most recent inpatient admission to the index date, looking back 36 months. Null if there was none.

name: procedures_12m
label: Procedures, last 12 months
description: Procedures recorded in the 12 months before the index date.

name: has_diabetes
label: Diabetes
description: 1 if a condition in the diabetes group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_prediabetes
label: Prediabetes
description: 1 if a condition in the prediabetes group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_hypertension
label: Hypertension
description: 1 if a condition in the hypertension group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_heart_failure
label: Heart failure
description: 1 if a condition in the heart failure group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_coronary_disease
label: Coronary disease
description: 1 if a condition in the coronary disease group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_atrial_fibrillation
label: Atrial fibrillation
description: 1 if a condition in the atrial fibrillation group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_stroke
label: Stroke
description: 1 if a condition in the stroke group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_copd
label: COPD
description: 1 if a condition in the COPD group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_asthma
label: Asthma
description: 1 if a condition in the asthma group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_chronic_kidney_disease
label: Chronic kidney disease
description: 1 if a condition in the chronic kidney disease group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_cancer
label: Cancer
description: 1 if a condition in the cancer group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_osteoarthritis
label: Osteoarthritis
description: 1 if a condition in the osteoarthritis group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_obesity
label: Obesity
description: 1 if a condition in the obesity group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_depression
label: Depression
description: 1 if a condition in the depression group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_anxiety
label: Anxiety
description: 1 if a condition in the anxiety group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_dementia
label: Dementia
description: 1 if a condition in the dementia group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_substance_use
label: Substance use
description: 1 if a condition in the substance use group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: has_chronic_pain
label: Chronic pain
description: 1 if a condition in the chronic pain group was active on the index date (onset before the index date).

name: chronic_group_count
label: Chronic condition groups
description: Number of the 18 chronic condition groups active on the index date.

name: new_chronic_groups_12m
label: New chronic condition groups
description: Chronic condition groups active on the index date that were not active 12 months earlier.

name: pregnant_at_index
label: Pregnant on index date
description: 1 if a pregnancy that began before the index date had not ended by it. Not one of the chronic groups.

name: active_medications
label: Active medications
description: Distinct medications started before the index date and not stopped before it.

name: new_medications_12m
label: Medications started, last 12 months
description: Distinct medications with an order started in the 12 months before the index date.

name: bmi
label: Body mass index
description: Latest body mass index in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: systolic_bp
label: Systolic blood pressure
description: Latest systolic blood pressure in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: diastolic_bp
label: Diastolic blood pressure
description: Latest diastolic blood pressure in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: hba1c
label: HbA1c
description: Latest hemoglobin A1c in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: egfr
label: eGFR
description: Latest estimated glomerular filtration rate in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: total_cholesterol
label: Total cholesterol
description: Latest total cholesterol in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: pain_score
label: Pain score
description: Latest self-reported pain severity (0 to 10) in the 24 months before the index date. Null if none.

name: hba1c_measured
label: HbA1c measured
description: 1 if an HbA1c result exists in the 24 months before the index date.

name: egfr_measured
label: eGFR measured
description: 1 if an eGFR result exists in the 24 months before the index date.

name: cholesterol_measured
label: Cholesterol measured
description: 1 if a total cholesterol result exists in the 24 months before the index date.
